_help: Act 1, encounter B, at Freddie's office after the debt collectors: armed men looking for Freddie (or what he left) think you're in on it. With musa_respect, Musa is one of them and won't shoot; talking them down works if Umm Sayed warned you about Finch (warned_finch: the police watch Finch's building); giving them Freddie's note (freddie_note) sends them to Alexandria (freddie_betrayed); 20 buys them off. Any of those: act1_confrontation_done + act1_gunfight_avoided (end_avoided). Drawing: event fight_armed_men (end_fight; the gun tutorial): on a win act1.gd sets act1_gunfight_won + act1_confrontation_done. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act1.py.

start.speaker: gunman
start.line: Nobody move. You're Mallory's friend. Where is he? He took something that belongs to our employer, and we think you know where.

musa_there.speaker: musa
musa_there.line: Wait. This one... this one helped me stand up. He knows nothing. I do not shoot him.

musa_leaves.speaker: gunman
musa_leaves.line: Musa! You fool! ...Fine. Fine! Tell Mallory we're still looking.

talk_down.speaker: player
talk_down.line: Three of them in Freddie's doorway. Pistols out. The leader's hand isn't steady.

choices.label: Talk him down
choices.line: You don't want this. This is Finch's building, and the police watch everything Finch owns. One shot and they're on the stairs. Walk away.

choices.label: Give them the note
choices.line: He's in Alexandria. Here's his note. Go and ask him yourself.

choices.label: Offer them money
choices.line: Twenty pounds to forget you ever climbed these stairs.

talk_works.speaker: gunman
talk_works.line: ...Police. Right. Finch's building. You're Finch's problem, not ours. Let's go.

talk_fails.speaker: gunman
talk_fails.line: Nice speech. Where's Mallory? Last time I ask.

choices.label: Offer them money
choices.line: All right, all right. Twenty pounds, and you walk.

note.speaker: gunman
note.line: Alexandria. There, that wasn't so hard. Come on.

bribe.speaker: gunman
bribe.line: Twenty. Generous man. If Mallory comes back, you never saw us.

avoided.speaker: player
avoided.line: Footsteps going down the stairs. My hand's still on the revolver.
